name: stock-7.6.8
description: Eight screens of the stock xteink_app 7.6.8 with the developer-menu patch: Home, the light panel, the nav menu, Settings, All Files (the Parity folder), a page of the parity book, the Mini Apps list and the cover of The Keeper of Gull Rock. Coordinates and boxes are portrait pixels (480 x 800, origin top left), the frame the stock draws and captures in.

say: Put one finger on the very top edge of the screen, on the line with the clock and the battery, and slide it slowly straight down, about a third of the screen.

The light panel opens: Brightness, Color Temp, four round buttons (Boost, Full Refresh, Sleep Lock, Light) and, at the bottom of the screen, three boxed buttons: "Memory Developer", "Screen Ca" and "BGIO Developer".
Tap the middle boxed button, "Screen Ca" (Screen Capture). The panel closes at once.

A small "Screenshot saved" label appears near the top. Then count slowly to five before the next tap: for about four seconds the label is still alive and would be drawn onto the next screen (it stays visible afterwards until something is redrawn; that is expected). If no label appears, take the capture again (an extra capture does no harm), except over the gamebook: over a Lua app the label never appears and the capture is saved all the same.

status-bar.why: status bar: clock, battery percentage and level, the WiFi glyph (WiFi is on on the device, off in the redacted copy)

menu-date.why: the nav menu's date and time line

system-font.say: The card selects the same system font as the mirror (MiSans DemiBold)
system-font.why: every line of UI text is drawn in it

language.say: Is the reader's menu in English (Read, All Files, USB, Cloud, Mini Apps, Settings)?
language.why: the emulator runs the NVS of the 2026-10-12 dump, language English

bookshelf.say: No book has ever been opened on this card, so Home says "Bookshelf Empty"
bookshelf.why: the stock keeps the bookshelf (recent books) in /XTData/reading/recent.xtbr; the September mirror has none

cloud-account.say: Does the first row of Settings still say "Unbound" (no Xteink cloud account bound)?
cloud-account.why: the account row is drawn from NVS (cloud_bind_st), as of the 2026-10-12 dump

reading-settings.say: Are Settings -> Reading settings (Font / Layout / Reading Style) as they were on 12 October (unchanged since)?
reading-settings.why: the reader page is laid out with the reading defaults from NVS, as of the 2026-10-12 dump

apps.say: /XTApps on the card holds exactly one app, gull-rock
apps.why: the Mini Apps list shows one card per app folder

gamebook.say: The gamebook on the card is the repository's apps/gull-rock (index.lua and manifest.json identical)
gamebook.why: the cover is drawn by the app's own index.lua

gamebook-state.say: The gamebook has no saved game on the card, so its cover offers only "Begin"
gamebook-state.why: with ctx.state saved (/XTApps/gull-rock/state.xtsv) the cover offers Continue / Begin again and counts endings found; the emulator's card is fresh

screens.title: Home (Bookshelf)
screens.expect: "Bookshelf" at the top left, ≡ at the top right, "Bookshelf Empty / Open a book from "All Files"" in the middle (or the books you have opened, if there are any)

steps.say: Start on Home: the Bookshelf page. If the reader shows anything else, touch the Home pad until the Bookshelf appears.

state.why: the bookshelf lists recently opened books

screens.title: The light panel
screens.expect: Brightness and Color Temp sliders, Boost / Full Refresh / Sleep Lock / Light, the three developer buttons at the bottom
screens.note: the stock closes the light panel before it captures (the capture holds the screen below it), so this screen has no device capture; the report shows the emulator's picture of it for comparing by eye

steps.say: Open the light panel: slide a finger down from the very top edge of the screen, as for a capture. Look at it; do NOT tap Screen Capture this time.

leave.say: Tap the dimmed page below the panel (the middle of the screen) to close it. The Bookshelf comes back.

screens.title: The nav menu
screens.expect: a menu on the right: Read (black, selected), All Files, USB, Cloud, Mini Apps, Settings, and the date at the bottom

steps.say: Tap the ≡ icon at the top right.

state.why: the dimmed Bookshelf shows to the left of the menu

screens.title: Settings
screens.expect: Unbound, General, Display & personalization, Network & connections, Buttons & interaction, Reading settings, About device

steps.say: Tap Settings (the last row of the menu, the gear icon).

screens.title: All Files, inside the Parity folder
screens.expect: "All Files" and the path "microSD / Parity", one row: "Parity Book.epub, EPUB | 3KB", and "0 folders 1 files" at the bottom

steps.say: Tap the folder Parity (the one the computer put on the card).

screens.title: The parity book, first page
screens.expect: "Chapter 1" at the top, then "Chapter 1, paragraph 1. The quick brown fox ...", the clock, "Chapter 1" and the battery in the footer

steps.say: Tap Parity Book.epub. Wait until the first page is drawn (it starts "Chapter 1, paragraph 1"). Do not turn the page.

state.why: font, size and margins of the reading layout

screens.title: Mini Apps
screens.expect: "Extensions", one card "The Keeper of Gull ...", and "1/1" and "1 books" at the bottom

steps.say: Touch the Home pad once: you are back in the Parity folder.

state.why: one card per app on the card

screens.title: The Keeper of Gull Rock, cover
screens.expect: the lighthouse picture, "The Keeper of GULL ROCK", "a gamebook", and a "Begin" box (Continue / Begin again if a game was saved)

steps.say: Tap the gamebook's card (The Keeper of Gull ...). Wait for the cover.

leave.say: Leave the gamebook as you usually do (Home pad, then Exit). Do not start a game: the cover is the last screen.

state.why: the choices under the title, and the endings-found line
the app draws the whole frame
